title: Crazy for Noam
description: A compilation of random pixel art of renowned linguist and activist Noam Chomsky.
body:
**THIS IS A PASTICHE PROJECT.**

This resource pack swaps a few items, blocks and entities in the game for semi-realistic  pictures of renowned linguist, intellectual and activist Noam Chomsky.

_"Syntax is sexy. Don’t let anyone diagram-shame you..”_

This pack features:
- Totem of undying
- Crafting table
- Skull on fire painting
- _MORE UPCOMING_
